definitions.explanation: Not treating people or cases according to the same standards; failing to respect the principles of fairness. Used of judgments, rules, trades, trials, distributions, and social conditions that systematically favor or disadvantage one side.

examples.japanese: {不公正|ふこうせい}な{判断|はんだん}。
{不公正|ふこうせい}な{取引|とりひき}を{許|ゆる}すわけにはいかない。
{不公正|ふこうせい}な{競争|きょうそう}が{業界|ぎょうかい}{全体|ぜんたい}に{悪影響|あくえいきょう}を{与|あた}えている。
examples.english: Unfair competition is having a bad effect on the entire industry.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}の{不公正|ふこうせい}を{是正|ぜせい}するために、{制度|せいど}{改革|かいかく}が{必要|ひつよう}だという{声|こえ}が{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Voices are rising to say that reform of the system is needed in order to correct social injustice.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (not) + {公正|こうせい} (fairness, justice, impartiality). The direct opposite of {公正|こうせい}. Functions as both a な-adjective ({不公正|ふこうせい}な{判断|はんだん}) and a noun ({社会|しゃかい}の{不公正|ふこうせい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な{取引|とりひき}: an unfair transaction / unfair trading
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な{競争|きょうそう}: unfair competition
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な{扱|あつか}い: unfair treatment
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な{判断|はんだん}: an unfair judgment
- {不公正|ふこうせい}な{制度|せいど}: an unfair system
- {不公正|ふこうせい}を{是正|ぜせい}する: to correct unfairness / injustice
- {不公正|ふこうせい}を{告発|こくはつ}する: to denounce an injustice

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不公平|ふこうへい}: unfair, partial — a near-synonym, more common in everyday conversation. {不公平|ふこうへい} tends to describe unequal treatment of individuals (one person getting more than another), while {不公正|ふこうせい} has a slightly more institutional flavor (rules or systems that fail to be just).
- {不当|ふとう}: unjust, unwarranted — focuses on the lack of proper grounds or justification.
- {不正|ふせい}: dishonest, wrongful, fraudulent — emphasizes moral or legal wrongdoing rather than unfairness.

REGISTER AND CONTEXT:
A formal word that is typical of news reporting, business writing, legal discussion, and commentary on social issues. In casual complaints about day-to-day unfairness, speakers usually say {不公平|ふこうへい}{だ} or {ずるい}.

ANTONYM:
- {公正|こうせい}: fair, just, impartial.
